howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在执行工具前后、用户提交提示、权限请求等环节运行自定义脚本，以修改、阻止或注入上下文。
howto.when: 当 Claude 执行工具、用户发送提示、权限对话框出现、会话开始/结束、子代理启动/停止等事件发生时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个钩子，在每次写文件后自动格式化。
阻止 Claude 读取 .env 文件。
say.note: 触发 PreToolUse 钩子，拒绝访问敏感文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs custom scripts before/after tool execution, on user prompt submit, permission requests, session start/end, subagent start/stop, etc., to modify, block, or inject context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude executes a tool, user submits a prompt, permission dialog appears, session starts/ends, subagent starts/stops, etc.

say_en.text: Write a hook to auto-format files after every write.
say_en.note: Triggers PostToolUse hook to format after Write tool.
Triggers PreToolUse hook to deny access to sensitive files.
